new_techniques.what: Black Forest Labs launched FLUX 3 (announced ~2026-07-25) as a hosted, closed API covering image, video up to 20s with native audio, i2v via pinned keyframes, v2v continuation from a clip's final frames, and a cached draft_enhance mode. It is not open weights; BFL's own launch plan puts an open-weight 'FLUX 3 Dev' last in the rollout with no date, licence or parameter count disclosed yet.
new_techniques.why_it_matters: It is a new native-audio, keyframe-consistent video product from the vendor behind flux-2, directly adjacent to the minimax-h3/ltx-2-5 native-audio-video comparison the atlas already runs — but it stays hosted-only, so it likely belongs in the ecosystem map as an out-of-scope note rather than the open-weight video ranking.
